page.layout: One page of text, with a running head at the top. Below the text, a short note-line "E X-" at the right, as a catchword or signature-like mark. No margin notes.

main_text.l: a. Vacillatio pedis hostium. Verf. 35. b.
b. Ultima ecclesia angustia decentiam maturandæ
liberationis includens. Verf. 36.
ç. Proterva hostium insultatio spem ecclesiæ
per amaram expostulationem irridens. Verf. 37. 38.
B. Deus Filius, dictis patris non solum accinens,
sed se paratum ad illud auxilium sistens; in cujus
sermone notetur.
1. Exordium, invitans ad attentionem, quâ
ejus magnitudinem ex viis ejus futuris animadvertant.
Verf. 39.
2. Spei à Deo datæ (de liberatione ecclesiæ
per ultionem ab hostibus sumendam) renovatio,
& sub juri juranJo confirmatio. Verf. 40.
3. Modi, quo judicium exerceret, terribilioris
expositio. Verf. 41. 42.
III. Tertii actus sermo epiphonema continet, excitans
ad jubilum, ubi occurrit,
A. Excitatio ipsa ad debitam regi acclamationem
faciendam. Verf. 43. a.
B. Confirmatio officii debiti ex rationibus, dignum
jubilatione argumentum proponentibus. Verf. 43. b.

page.notes: Some print is faint and smudged, especially in the lower half. "juri juranJo" reads as printed, with the odd capital J; the word is uncertain. The catchword "E X-" is partly obscured. The heading "III." is set in roman type, not capitals, so level 2 is a judgement call. Stains and show-through are ignored.
